Subject: Reminder: Punctuality for Client Meetings

Dear Team,

I am writing to remind everyone of the importance of punctuality for our client meetings. Being on time is a key reflection of our company’s professionalism and respect for our clients.

We have noticed a recent pattern of tardiness, which we need to address immediately. Please ensure that you are arriving at meetings on time moving forward. Consistent lateness can impact our professional reputation and may lead to further disciplinary measures.

Thank you for your attention to this matter and for your commitment to maintaining our high standards.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
